title: IpfsStore: add get_raw() method for block retrieval
description: The IpfsStore trait currently only has put_raw(). To export a CAR file, we need to fetch block bytes by CID. Add get_raw(&self, cid: &Cid) -> Result<Vec<u8>, IpfsError> to the IpfsStore trait in peering/pipeline.rs, implement in MemIpfsStore (return from HashMap) and RustIpfsStore (call ipfs.get_block(cid)).
